name: Orion
source:
A senior majoring in Digital Science (An Interdisciplinary major combining Human Computer Interaction, Industrial Design, and Programming) at a TSUN.

The brother of Ann.

He's naturally blonde but dyes his hair to look tougher. His favorite food is Lingonberry.
